decisions.name: Valletta
decisions.reason: The earlier Malta investigation explicitly queried the Valletta/Grand Harbour area and retained the original WFS parcel response. The prior capital roster names Valletta, Malta and places its city locator 1.28 km from the WUP settlement point. This is a prior investigation of the same city, so WUP78 is a confirmed prior attempt and remains out of the pending queue. The WUP rank, point and 373474-person population are unchanged; this decision does not qualify or enable a live adapter, and the registered-land sample does not prove citywide coverage.

decisions.name: La Paz
decisions.reason: The named sample is from the municipal cadastre of La Paz, Bolivia: its source coordinates are near 16.5° S, 68.15° W and the prior packet explicitly identifies Bolivia. WUP1122 is La Paz, Mexico at 24.1214845987258° N, 110.31000709561° W. The La Paz municipal government in Baja California Sur independently identifies the Mexican city. The prior Bolivian sample is not an attempt on WUP1122. Keep its original rank, point and 372988-person population and move it to pending research; Mexican parcel custody, public geometry and runtime readiness remain unverified.

decisions.name: Taizhou
decisions.reason: The WUP11424 point at 32.4835458969483° N, 119.923670465704° E is inside the official Jiangsu 泰州 coordinate envelope. The earlier WUP12098 packet is for 浙江台州 at 28.5733123079214° N, 121.395147887368° E, about 457 km away. Official Jiangsu and Zhejiang municipal pages distinguish 泰州 from 台州. WUP12098 is not an attempt on WUP11424. Keep the candidate’s original rank, point and 371055-person population and move it to pending research; its local parcel custody and public geometry remain unverified.

decisions.name: London
decisions.priorSourceScope: City of Westminster, England, United Kingdom
decisions.reason: The WUP 2025 original row identifies City_Code 2303 as London, Canada at 42.9854320723653 N, 81.246421845116 W with 362006 persons and rank 1579. The City of London municipal page independently identifies London, Ontario. Both name-matched earlier research files concern London, England: the original file records HM Land Registry coverage of England and Wales, and the retry obtained City_of_Westminster.zip with British National Grid polygon coordinates around Charing Cross. They are not a prior investigation of the Canadian settlement. Preserve the immutable WUP identity and move code 2303 to pending research. Ontario parcel custody, public geometry, and adapter qualification remain unverified; this decision does not enable the city or imply absence.

Retained extract from that original UK download has EPSG:27700 coordinates and native INSPIRE IDs; no new polygons retained.
Official municipal page explicitly identifies London, Ontario.
